credits.title: Crawlers
credits.overview: Tenants at Paradiso Palms apartments fight a deadly spider invasion while the cunning building manager might be their only hope for survival.

credits.title: Ham on Rye
credits.overview: A bizarre rite of passage at the local deli determines the fate of a generation of teenagers, leading some to escape their suburban town and dooming others to remain.

credits.title: Dear Mom
credits.overview: After discovering she's pregnant, a young painter reaches out to her estranged mother to seek advice on whether or not she's ready to raise her own child.

credits.title: Home Is Where The Killer Is
credits.overview: What if Dee Dee Blanchard was a rich lady doctor who preyed on her roommates and also loved to watch Downton Abbey?

credits.title: Zemanovaload
credits.overview: John Davies suffers from multiple obsessive compulsive disorders. When his current model girlfriend leaves him, he decides to replace her with the number 1 babe on planet Earth - Czech model Veronika Zemanova. The film follows his attempts to curb his old obsessions in order to meet his latest obsession - Veronika.
